pass_law: at least 2 of 6 independent axes differ by >= 25% relative effect, and the negative controls fail
progress: the swatch DOES separate the two materials — highlight full width at half maximum differs by 57% relative effect, which the three-quarter palette view could not show at all. The fixture works.

ROOT_CAUSE.finding: the characterization rig produces almost no specular lobe. SPECULAR_TO_DIFFUSE_RATIO is 1.13 for matte and 1.07 for satin — a value near 1.0 means the render is essentially pure diffuse, so five of the six axes have no signal to carry.
ROOT_CAUSE.why: the key is a 260 mm area light at 9.0e4 — very broad and dim. A specular highlight needs a compact, brighter source; a large soft box spreads the reflection until it merges with the diffuse base.
not_the_cause: the material definitions themselves — FWHM proves they differ
ROOT_CAUSE.scene_linear_confirms: peak linear 0.18-0.23 with ZERO clipping, so the missing lobe is genuinely absent rather than clipped away

what_was_NOT_done: no threshold was lowered — the 25% effect size and the 2-axis requirement were declared before measurement and stand
satin was not made glossy to cross a metric
the pair was not declared distinct on the one clearing axis
next: add a compact high-intensity specular source to the characterization rig so a lobe exists, then re-measure against the unchanged pass law
